title: 2.2 Verifying Trigonometric Identities

icans: I can prove a trig identity by working one side until it matches the other.

vocab: an ___________ that is true for every value in its domain
__________ only for some values (those are the solutions)
show the ___________ is true for EVERY x, working one side at a time

used to add or subtract trig ____________
